bottle.text:
You got bored stuck at home doing nothing, so you planned to go camping at a camp site.
Your objective is to have fun and well... survive.
Before you leave the house, you almost forgot to bring a water bottle.
You have 2 options, which one will you pick?

choice.1:
You grabbed the Metal bottle.
You grab your car, and leave the house.
choice.2:
You grabbed the Glass bottle.
You grab your car, and leave the house.

raccoon.text:
You arrive at the camping site and start building your tent.
While you're building the tent, you see a raccoon wandering trying to find food.
It looks hungry, what do you want to do?

choice.1:
You fed the raccoon a slice of bread. After eating, the raccoon leaves the camp site.
*The Raccoon will remember this*
choice.2:
You continue building the tent, the raccoon searches the area food.
Right before you finish building, the raccoon wanders off

bird.text:
You finishing building the tent.
You take a break by eating an avoccado before you start making the campfire.
While your eating, you see a small bird looking at you curiously.
what do you want to do?

choice.1:
You slice up some of your avoccado and put it on a paper plate, placing it on the ground.
The bird flies towards the avocado, looks at it, and eats it.
The bird is enjoying the avoccado, but after a while, the bird 'faints' from avocado poisoning.
You feel guilty for giving the avocado.
choice.2: You ignore the bird, the bird leaves

deer.textglass:
While you are starting the campfire, you accidentaly bump your glass bottle and it breaks.
You feel very sad.
deer.text:
You just made your campfire.
While you're by the fire cooking, you hear a rattle from a far.
You look at that direction and you see a baby deer wodering around
It looks scared, do you want to approach it?

choice.1:
You don't want to leave the campfire alone, so you just stay put.
The deer leaves the other direction
choice.2:
You approach the deer to see if its ok, the baby deer shouts and runs away from you.
Right after that you hear loud roar from afar. You run back to the campsite, to get to safety.
You see a mama deer run past the campsite looking for the baby.
You feel scared.

bear.text:
After you finish cooking and eating, you go head to sleep.
From afar you see a baby cub and a mama bear walking by the campsite.
What are you gonna do?

choice.1:
You try to scare the bares away from the camp site.
The mama bear feels treatened and runs at you.
You try to run away, but you were too slow for the bear.
You're fading black
choice.2:
You feel too tired to do anything.
So you head to sleep hoping that the bears dont eat you
choice.3:
You understand that its way too risky to stay here with the bears around.
You leave you belongings, including your tent, take your car, and drive away from the campsite.
You parked in a parking lot and sleep in the car

clean.textno:
You wake up the next day.
Getting out of the tent and see that the camsite is full of trash that you left.
Before you leave the camsite, do you want to clean the place?
clean.textrac:
You wake up the next day.
Getting out of the tent you see a gaze of raccoons rummiging your stuff.
You scare them off and they run away. You see the campsite full of trash and you stuff scattered around.
Before you leavethe campsite, do you want to clean the place?
clean.textcar:
You wake up the next day and drive back to the campsite.
Once you arrive there, you see the campsite and your stuff mostly intact, but there is quite a bit of trash around the campsite.
Before you leave the camsite, do you want to clean the place?
clean.textraccar:
You wake up the next day and drive back to the campsite.
Once you arrive there, you see a gaze of raccoons rummiging your stuff.
You honk the horn and the racoons run away. You see the campsite full of trash and you stuff scattered around.
Before you leavethe campsite, do you want to clean the place?

choice.1:
After what has happend, you dont wanna stay here any longer.
So you pack your stuff, and drive off.
choice.2:
You dont want to be a rude person, so start cleaning the area.
After that you pack your stuff, and drive off.
